_README: Cross-language parity fixtures. Driven by BOTH api/spec/services/cross_language_parity_spec.rb (Ruby) and ui/desktop/core/src/parity_tests.rs (Rust). 'agreed' cases must produce the SAME output on both engines. 'divergences' cases capture behaviour that still DIFFERS, each with a per-engine expected value ('ruby'/'rust'). See fixtures/parity/README.md for the drift report and what has been reconciled.

divergences.name: lone known tag in prose
divergences.body_plain: email me at <a> or use <name> placeholder; compare 5 < 10 and 10 > 5
divergences.ruby: email me at <a> or use <name> placeholder; compare 5 < 10 and 10 > 5
divergences.rust: email me at or use <name> placeholder; compare 5 < 10 and 10 > 5
divergences.note: Rust's strip_known_tags drops a lone known-element tag (the tracking-pixel pass); Ruby has no residual-tag strip, so the tag survives. Unknown '<name>' words and stray '<' stay prose on both.

divergences.name: space before colon
divergences.note: Not reconciled (only language coverage was asked for). Rust trims whitespace between prefix and colon; Ruby requires the colon to immediately follow the prefix.

divergences.name: CJK with full-width colon
divergences.note: Not reconciled. Rust accepts the full-width colon U+FF1A after a CJK prefix; Ruby only recognises an ASCII colon.

divergences.name: CJK with no colon
divergences.note: Not reconciled. Rust strips an East-Asian ideographic prefix even with no colon; Ruby requires a colon.

divergences.name: parenthesised count
divergences.note: Not reconciled. Rust accepts (n) and [n] count markers; Ruby only accepts [n].

divergences.name: over-long list tag (45 chars)
divergences.note: Not reconciled. Ruby caps list-tag content at 40 chars; Rust has no length cap.

divergences.name: list tag with nothing after it
divergences.note: Not reconciled. Ruby strips a leading list tag unconditionally (yielding empty); Rust keeps it when no subject text follows.
